name: US jobless claims
summary: US initial jobless claims 200,000 in the week to 7 Nov; 4-week average 195,250, at its 52-week low
state: FRED data show initial US jobless claims of 200,000 in the week to 7 Nov, with the four-week average at 195,250, its 52-week low and far below the 15% Watch line. Layoffs remain low by historical standards as of 16 Nov. The Labor Department's next weekly figures, for the week to 14 Nov, are due on 19 Nov (Finance Calendar).
for_you: New layoffs in the US remain low, so job security for most workers is broadly normal. Workers in sectors hit by higher rates are most exposed if that changes.
rubric_hit: 4-week average 0% above 52-week low, under 15% Watch line: Normal

why: Weekly claims are the earliest hard data on US layoffs; a sustained rise usually comes before the unemployment rate turns.
